as_prepends.id.description: The unique identifier for this AS Prepend.

as_prepends.length.description: Number of times the ASN to appended to the AS Path.

as_prepends.policy.description: Route type this AS Prepend applies to

as_prepends.prefix.description: Comma separated list of prefixes this AS Prepend applies to. If empty, this applies to all prefixes.

as_prepends.specific_prefixes.description: Array of prefixes this AS Prepend applies to. This parameter is not returned when AS Prepend applies to all prefixes. Note that ordering is not significant and may differ from request order.

authentication_key.description: A reference to a [Hyper Protect Crypto Service Standard Key](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/hs-crypto?topic=hs-crypto-get-started).

bfd_status.description: Gateway BFD status. The list of enumerated values for this property may expand in the future. Code and processes using this field must tolerate unexpected values.

bfd_status_updated_at.description: Date and time bfd status was updated

bgp_base_cidr.description: (DEPRECATED) BGP base CIDR is deprecated and no longer recognized by the Direct Link APIs. See bgp_cer_cidr and bgp_ibm_cidr fields instead for IP related information. Deprecated field bgp_base_cidr will be removed from the API specification after 15-MAR-2021.

carrier_name.description: Carrier name. Only set for type=dedicated gateways.

connection_mode.description: Type of services this Gateway is attached to. Mode transit means this Gateway will be attached to Transit Gateway Service and direct means this Gateway will be attached to vpc or classic connection. The list of enumerated values for this property may expand in the future. Code and processes using this field must tolerate unexpected values.

cross_connect_router.description: Cross connect router. Only included on type=dedicated gateways.

customer_name.description: Customer name. Only set for type=dedicated gateways.

default_export_route_filter.description: The default directional route filter action that applies to routes that do not match any directional route filters.

default_import_route_filter.description: The default directional route filter action that applies to routes that do not match any directional route filters.

export_route_filters.prefix.description: Comma separated list of prefixes this AS Prepend applies to. If empty, this applies to all prefixes.

global.description: Gateways with global routing (`true`) can connect to networks outside their associated region.

import_route_filters.prefix.description: Comma separated list of prefixes this AS Prepend applies to. If empty, this applies to all prefixes.

macsec_config.active.description: Indicates if the MACsec feature is currently active (true) or inactive (false) for a direct link.

metered.description: Metered billing option. When `true` gateway usage is billed per gigabyte. When `false` there is no per gigabyte usage charge, instead a flat rate is charged for the gateway.

name.description: The unique user-defined name for this gateway.

speed_mbps.description: Gateway speed in megabits per second

type.description: Offering type. The list of enumerated values for this property may expand in the future. Code and processes using this field must tolerate unexpected values.

vlan.description: VLAN configured for this gateway. If there is no vlan configured for the gateway, the vlan will be absent. This property will also be absent if this gateway's `crn` is in another account.

export_route_filters.before.description: Identifier of the next route filter considered if a route does not match the current filter. This property builds the ordering among route filters and follows semantics: - When before is an identifier of a route filter that exists and is in the same collection, a route will first attempt to match on the current filter before preceding to the filter referenced in this property. - When a filter is c

import_route_filters.before.description: Identifier of the next route filter considered if a route does not match the current filter. This property builds the ordering among route filters and follows semantics: - When before is an identifier of a route filter that exists and is in the same collection, a route will first attempt to match on the current filter before preceding to the filter referenced in this property. - When a filter is c

macsec_config.window_size.description: The window size determines the number of frames in a window for replay protection. Replay protection is used to counter replay attacks. Frames within a window size can be out of order and are not replay protected.

name.description: The name identifies the connectivity association key (CAK) within the MACsec key chain. The CAK's `name` must be a hexadecimal string of even lengths between 2 to 64 inclusive. This value, along with the material of the `key`, must match on the MACsec peers.

session.description: The intended session the key will be used to secure. If the `primary` MACsec session fails due to a key/key name mismatch on the peers, the `fallback` session can take over. There must be a `primary` session CAK. A `fallback` CAK is optional.

active.description: Sets the MACsec feature to be active (true) or inactive (false) for a direct link.

sak_rekey.interval.description: The time, in seconds, to force a Secure Association Key (SAK) rekey.

sak_rekey.mode.description: Determines that the SAK rekey occurs based on the used packet numbers.

security_policy.description: Determines how packets without MACsec headers are handled. - `must_secure` - Packets without MACsec headers are dropped. Use this policy to prefer security over network availability. - `should_secure` - Packets without MACsec headers are allowed. Use this policy to prefer network availability over security.

window_size.description: The window size determines the number of frames in a window for replay protection. Replay protection is used to counter replay attacks. Frames within a window size can be out of order and are not replay protected.

caks.session.description: The intended session the key will be used to secure. If the `primary` MACsec session fails due to a key/key name mismatch on the peers, the `fallback` session can take over. There must be a `primary` session CAK. A `fallback` CAK is optional.

bgp_asn.description: BGP ASN. For a 2-byte range, enter a value between 1-64495 or 64999. For a 2-byte or 4-byte range, enter a value between 131072-4199999999. For a 4-byte range, enter a value between 4201000000-4201064511.

vlan.description: VLAN requested for this gateway. VLAN provided should be in the range 2 to 3967.

name.description: The user-defined name for this virtual connection. Virtual connection names are unique within a gateway. This is the name of the virtual connection itself, the network being connected may have its own name attribute.

network_id.description: Unique identifier of the target network. For type=vpc virtual connections this is the CRN of the target VPC. This field does not apply to type=classic connections.
